marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Pop culture: a view from the paparazzi

"Orlando Bloom became famous thanks to his portrayal of the brave elf Legolas in "The Lord of the Rings" movies. He went on to even greater fame as Will Turner, the blacksmith-turned-pirate of the "Pirates of the Caribbean" series of films. This handsome English actor has charmed millions of fans and become one of the most popular stars of his day. Orlando never expected such fame and attention. e grew up surrounded by the arts and always wanted to be an actor, but he expected to work on the stage. He was suddenly thrust intot he spotlight thanks to his high-profile movie roles, and has struggled to grow as an actor while also heaving a healthy personal life. This book shows why Orlando Bloom considers himself lucky, and follows the surprising twists and turns of his life and career as one of the hottest young stars in Hollywood."
